context: A boss reviews a corporate issue
purpose: Teach: 人的/地上波/成り立ち/林業/沼/沿線/練っ/質感

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Human resources is the strategic core of everything we do.
lines.style: Direct, declarative. Firm opening. Even pacing. Authority without shouting. A man stating fact rather than opinion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報、地上波枠、確保しました。
lines.en: Yes. We've secured the terrestrial broadcast slot for PR.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Crisp consonants. Even rhythm. Report-style confidence — he's done what was asked and is stating it plainly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の成り立ち、若手にも、伝えろ。
lines.en: Make sure the younger staff understand the industry's origins.
lines.style: Clear instruction. Slight pause after the opening word. No-nonsense tone. The voice of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。林業との共同事業、検討しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently reviewing a potential joint venture with a forestry firm.
lines.style: Calm status update. Steady tempo. Slight lift on the verb — 'reviewing' — to show active progress. Competent, unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 沼地の土地、開発、慎重に。
lines.en: The marshland development — approach it carefully.
lines.style: Weighted pause after the dash. Deliberate, measured delivery. The word 'carefully' lands with quiet emphasis. Advisory but firm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。沿線広告、効果測定、進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with measuring the effectiveness of the roadside advertising.
lines.style: Steady professional tone. Clean articulation. Slight emphasis on 'effectiveness' — the metric matters. Methodical, no wasted words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 戦略を練ったうえで、来期、ローンチだ。
lines.en: Once the strategy is properly developed, we launch next quarter.
lines.style: Command tone but not harsh. Slight emphasis on 'properly' — quality of planning is non-negotiable. Even pace building to the final word with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品の質感、最終確認、こだわります。
lines.en: Yes. We're being meticulous about the final quality check on the product itself.
lines.style: Close attention in the voice. Slower, deliberate pacing. Small nod of respect in the tone — this is what matters now. Care without fussiness.
